knobs.note: BH-8706: the label the breaker puts on every queued PR of a red repo and removes on green. The non-hotfix Mergify queue_rules exclude it in their queue_conditions (config/mergify/template.yml, bin/mergify-template.sh PAUSE_LABEL, .mergify.yml), and mc_queue_left_why answers paused on it. Read by bin/main-red-breaker.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BREAKER_PAUSE_LABEL:-merge-queue-paused}. settable:false (BH-8706 review): the Mergify files hold the literal, so a value changed from a page would label PRs that Mergify does not exclude, and the pause would fail open. A change is a PR that edits PAUSE_LABEL and re-renders every Mergify conf (bin/mergify-sync.sh apply).
BH-8706: the most PRs one tick pauses (or resumes) per repo; a list at the cap logs `pause: capped` and the next tick goes on. Read by bin/main-red-breaker.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BREAKER_MAX_PRS:-50}.
BH-8706: the most failed jobs the hotfix ticket lists. Read by bin/main-red-breaker.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BREAKER_MAX_JOBS:-5}.
BH-8706: the most failure annotations (failing test lines) the hotfix ticket lists per failed job; 0 reads none. Read by bin/main-red-breaker.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BREAKER_MAX_ANNOTATIONS:-10}.
BH-8706: the most suspect merges (between the last green and the red sha) the hotfix ticket lists. Read by bin/main-red-breaker.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BREAKER_MAX_SUSPECTS:-20}.

BH-8706: the comma-separated labels of the hotfix ticket. Read by bin/main-red-breaker.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BREAKER_TICKET_LABELS:-ai-build,hotfix}; a value that is not a label list falls back to the default.
BH-8706: 1 files one hotfix ticket per red episode; 0 = pause and resume only. Read by bin/main-red-breaker.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BREAKER_TICKETS:-1}.

BH-8706: a JSON object {"<owner>/<repo>": "<regex>"} that replaces the global main-red skip regex (lane.main-red-pr-pair.main_red_skip_re) for that repo only, so a repo whose push-to-main run executes its impacted E2E can count that workflow as required. Read by bin/main-red-detector.sh once per pass; bad JSON or a regex that does not compile is logged and the global value is used. {} = no repo overridden.

Test seam: a file bin/main-red-breaker.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 (tests/main-red-breaker.bh-8706-test.sh). NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/main-red-breaker.sh sources MAIN_RED_BREAKER_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
